gpt_prompt:
Extract the candidate's profile from the raw resume text below.
Return a JSON object matching the following structure:
{
  "name": "Candidate Full Name",
  "email": "candidate.email@example.com",
  "phone": "phone-number",
  "location": "City, State/Country",
  "skills": ["Skill1", "Skill2"],
  "experience_years": 0,
  "education": [
    {
      "school": "School/University Name",
      "degree": "Degree/Major Name",
      "year": "Year"
    }
  ],
  "experience": [
    {
      "company": "Company Name",
      "title": "Job Title",
      "duration": "Duration/Dates",
      "description": "Key responsibilities"
    }
  ],
  "projects": [
    {
      "title": "Project Title",
      "description": "Project Description",
      "technologies": ["Tech1", "Tech2"],
      "duration": "Duration/Dates"
    }
  ],
  "certifications": ["Cert1", "Cert2"],
  "languages": ["Language1", "Language2"]
}

Guidelines:
- Replace all placeholders in the structure above with the candidate's actual data.
- If the candidate has no professional experience, 'experience' must be an empty list [] and 'experience_years' must be 0.
- If any field (e.g. location, certifications, languages) is not mentioned in the resume, set it to null or an empty list []. Do not guess.

Raw Resume Text:
Jane Doe - Senior Python Engineer
jane@example.com | +1-555-0100
Skills: Python, FastAPI, PostgreSQL, Redis, Docker, AWS
Experience: 5 years backend engineering
